blocks.text:
## Journey highlights

The first part of the route is by air. After meeting in Manaus, you will head to the pier for an approximately 30-minute seaplane flight over the Rio Negro.

From above, you can see dark water and vast expanses of forest without urban development.

The main base for the journey is Mirante do Gavião Amazon Lodge.

Mirante do Gavião is a VIP lodge whose design draws on Amazonian boatbuilding traditions and faces the Anavilhanas archipelago.

The lodge has 13 suites, a swimming pool, a spa, the CamuCamu restaurant, a pier and viewing platforms above the river.

Anavilhanas National Park is considered the world's largest river archipelago and comprises more than 400 islands.

The programme depends on water levels. Beaches and land routes are accessible in the dry season; during the rainy season, parts of the forest are flooded and the boat travels between the trees.

The final day focuses on the Meeting of the Waters of the Rio Negro and Solimões and swimming with pink dolphins.

## Mirante do Gavião Amazon Lodge

The lodge stands on the bank of the Rio Negro, opposite the Anavilhanas archipelago.

The lodge has 13 suites.

Facilities include a swimming pool, a spa, the CamuCamu restaurant, a pier and viewing platforms.

The lodge's architecture is inspired by Amazonian boatbuilding traditions.

The programme combines active excursions into the jungle and along the river with a return to a comfortable lodge after each outing.

## Format and seasons

The route on Day 2 depends on water levels.

The dry season offers more land sections, beaches and walks through unflooded forest.

During the rainy season, water enters the forest, so part of the route is by boat through flooded areas.

The Anavilhanas archipelago comprises more than 400 islands, so the specific water and land sections of the programme are chosen according to seasonal river and forest conditions.

The order of activities may change depending on natural conditions.

Private excursions and transfers are included in the programme.

The main guide speaks English.

An English-speaking guide can travel from Rio.
